name: The Sun Misses the Moon
source:
Sol is like any typical freshman college student. Except he doesn't have any particular talents and the only reason he's in college at all is because his best friend dragged him there.

What is the story behind his friend's family?

Why does his friend care so much about him?

What's up with his weirdass brother?

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/rpg/the-sun-misses-the-moon/45012/]Game Jolt[/url]]
translation:
索尔就像普通的大一新生一样，只是他没有任何特别的才能，之所以会上大学，也只是因为最好的朋友把他拉了过来。

他朋友的家族背后究竟有什么故事？

朋友为什么如此在意他？

那个古怪至极的哥哥又是怎么回事？

[来自[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/rpg/the-sun-misses-the-moon/45012/]Game Jolt[/url]]
